about_the_game:
Description:

Step into the boots of a rookie officer in cLocked In, a fast-paced open-world police simulator set in a vibrant, low-poly, fantasy city where humans, orcs, elves, and goblins coexist—and crime never sleeps. You're the newest recruit on the force, starting small but dreaming big. From writing parking tickets in quiet suburbs to breaking up dangerous drug rings and surviving magical shootouts, your rise through the ranks begins now.

Explore Four Unique Districts:

  • Hannara – Human-dominated suburban streets with minor infractions and neighborhood disputes.

  • Morgatelis – Glittering skyscrapers housing wealthy elves and goblins—and the white-collar crimes they commit.

  • DelDedria – A gritty, dangerous zone home to orcs and humans, where gang violence and illegal deals run rampant.

  • Colezaria – An industrial wasteland policed with grit, where orc laborers and criminal rings clash in the factories.

Gameplay & Features:

🛡️ Tier-Based Crime Response

  • Tier 1 (Low-Risk): Chase down fleeing suspects such as graffiti artists, write parking tickets, and detain petty criminals using handcuffs.

  • Tier 2 (Medium-Risk): Use your trusty baton to break up street fights, control vandalism, and disarm and detain drug dealers.

  • Tier 3 (High-Risk): Gear up with a pistol and deploy a futuristic shield to face magical shootouts, bomb threats, and organized bank robberies.

🎖️ Level Up Your Officer
Earn XP and credits by resolving crimes correctly—non-lethal takedowns and appropriate force earn bigger rewards. Level up to take on more dangerous assignments, access higher crime tiers, and unlock perks and cosmetics.

🚓 Customize Your Loadout
Spend your hard-earned credits on:

  • Weapon camos for your pistol and baton

  • New police vehicles including high-speed cars and bikes

  • Weapon upgrades such as ranged and melee damage output as well as magazine size

🎰 Live the Off-Duty Life
Take a break from justice and explore city life:

  • Hit the casino and try your luck at four unique table games using the credits you earn in game

  • Socialize with NPCs, explore district cultures

🔓 Master Your Role
Climb from rookie patrol to elite enforcer. With every promotion (level up), you'll unlock access to new camos, special achievements to unlock vehicles, and the trust of your precinct to handle the city's darkest corners.

What are you waiting for? Serve by the book to bring justice your way. The city awaits, Officer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: None

short_description: Step into the boots of a rookie city police guard in a sprawling fantasy metropolis. Uphold the law, take on escalating missions, and rise through the ranks from parking tickets to deadly confrontations. Customize your gear, explore the city, and maybe lose your paycheck at the local casino.
